/bin/zsh -lc "./run_python -c 'import app

def rejected(parser, data):
    try:
        parser.feed(data)
    except app.StreamError:
        assert parser.state == \"FAILED\"
        assert parser.buffered_bytes == 0
        for action in (lambda: parser.feed(b\"\"), parser.finish):
            try:
                action()
            except app.StreamError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError(\"failed parser was reusable\")
    else:
        raise AssertionError(\"expected StreamError\")

p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=16)
assert p.feed(b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\"}\\n\") == [{\"event\":\"done\",\"text\":\"\",\"characters\":0,\"words\":0}]
assert p.buffered_bytes == 0 and p.finish() == p.finish() == []

p = app.EventStream()
wire = \"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"雪\\\"}\\n{\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\"}\\n\".encode()
i = wire.index(\"雪\".encode()) + 1
assert p.feed(wire[:i]) == []
assert p.feed(wire[i:]) == [{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"雪\"}, {\"event\":\"done\",\"text\":\"雪\",\"characters\":1,\"words\":1}]
assert p.finish() == []
assert app.text_metrics(\" a\\u2003b \") == {\"characters\":5,\"words\":2}

p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=16)
small_frames = b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"\\\"}\\n\" * 80
assert len(small_frames) > p.max_buffer
assert len(p.feed(small_frames)) == 80
assert p.buffered_bytes == 0 and p.state == \"OPEN\"
assert p.feed(b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\"}\\n\")[0][\"event\"] == \"done\"

for wire in [b\"\\n\", b\"{\", b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\",\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\"}\\n\", b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":NaN}\\n\", b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":1}\\n\"]:
    rejected(app.EventStream(), wire)
rejected(app.EventStream(max_buffer=4), b\"12345\")
rejected(app.EventStream(), b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"x\\\"}\\n{\\\"event\\\":\\\"done\\\"}\\nX\")
p = app.EventStream()
try:
    p.feed(b\"{\\\"event\\\":\\\"token\\\",\\\"text\\\":\\\"x\\\"}\\n\\n\")
except app.StreamError:
    assert p.state == \"FAILED\" and p.buffered_bytes == 0
else:
    raise AssertionError(\"partial output failure was not raised\")
print(\"targeted checks passed\")' && ./run_python smoke.py"
